projection.purpose: Share readable typographic roles without sharing brand colors.

contract.input: Project palette, native font policy and semantic text roles.
contract.step: Use the EMBO-inspired Segoe UI, Arial, sans-serif stack with native fallbacks.
Use body, interface and metadata roles instead of isolated tiny labels.
Check Cyrillic, Latin, zoom, narrow screens, keyboard focus and both themes.
contract.invariant: A label must communicate an object, action or state; system fonts need no redistributed binary.

test.given: A new Workshop adopts the shared roles.
test.then: The interface stays readable without inheriting another product brand.
